subject.title: Feature: Add per-model generation timeout config

question: Should OpenClaw expose the existing per-model request-timeout path as the public total-attempt deadline, and what exact precedence and fallback semantics should it have relative to the current global run timeout?
rationale: The issue asks for new configuration surface and operator-visible failure semantics; source discussion identifies multiple adjacent timeout concepts, so an automated repair should not choose the permanent public contract.

options.title: Adopt one per-model request deadline
options.body: Expose a single documented per-model request timeout with model-over-default precedence and retain current behavior when it is absent.

options.title: Add a distinct generation timeout
options.body: Create a separate total-generation setting with explicit semantics distinct from request, idle, and first-token timeouts.

options.title: Keep timeout tuning global
options.body: Decline per-model configuration and address model-specific latency through provider or model-routing policy only.

recommendation.title: Adopt one per-model request deadline
recommendation.body: Expose a single documented per-model request timeout with model-over-default precedence and retain current behavior when it is absent.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior maintainer review already framed the remaining configuration and runner-contract decision.
